basic_info.description: 4606 Cabrillo Street is a 3,520+/- square foot 3 unit multi-family property located on a 2,395 square foot lot in the desirable Outer Richmond neighborhood. The building comprises three well-maintained residential units: two (2) two-bedroom, one-bathroom units, and one (1) three-bedroom, two-bathroom unit. Each unit boasts a thoughtful blend of carpet and hardwood flooring, spacious closets, and modern conveniences such as garbage disposals and dishwashers. All units are separately metered for electricity, ensuring efficient utility management.  The property includes three garage parking spaces, a highly sought-after feature in the area. Public transportation, scenic walking paths, and access to commuter routes make this property an excellent investment opportunity in one of San Francisco's most notable and picturesque neighborhoods. Renowned for its breathtaking coastal views of the Pacific Ocean, neighboring iconic landmarks Golden Gate Park,Lands End, Sutro Baths. This vibrant area combines laid back residential streets with a diverse mix of locally owned cafes, restaurants, boutique shops, bakeries, wellness studios, pre-schools and everyday conveniences. Truly a quintessential San Francisco lifestyle. Offer date 2/4/25 at 3:00pm.
